The query joins Montgomery tracts to EPA facility counts and CDC adult asthma prevalence, computes facilities per 1,000 residents, keeps only tracts with non-null paired values, and returns the correlation and paired-tract count as window statistics ranked by facility density descending.
sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    t.geoid,
    t.name,
    COALESCE(CAST(tc.n AS DOUBLE), 0) AS facility_count,
    CAST(p.totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation,
    CAST(p.casthma_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS adult_asthma_prevalence
  FROM fw_pg.tracts t
  LEFT JOIN fw_pg.tract_counts tc
    ON tc.geoid = t.geoid
   AND tc.run_id = 'r_20261026_0a10d7'
   AND tc.source = 'm1_cdc'
   AND tc.grp = 'all'
  LEFT JOIN session.fw_0a10d7_m2_cdc p
    ON p.tractfips = t.geoid
),
paired AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    facility_count / NULLIF(totalpopulation, 0) * 1000 AS epa_facilities_per_1000_residents
  FROM base
  WHERE adult_asthma_prevalence IS NOT NULL
    AND totalpopulation IS NOT NULL
    AND totalpopulation > 0
)
SELECT
  name,
  epa_facilities_per_1000_residents,
  facility_count,
  totalpopulation,
  adult_asthma_prevalence,
  CORR(epa_facilities_per_1000_residents, adult_asthma_prevalence) OVER () AS epa_facilities_per_1000_residents_vs_adult_asthma_prevalence_corr,
  COUNT(*) OVER () AS paired_tracts,
  geoid
FROM paired
ORDER BY epa_facilities_per_1000_residents DESC NULLS LAST, name ASC
LIMIT 200
